The cPad is an external network terminal, fitted with a touch screen, intended to print job release 
from any peripheral. Copies, prints and scans are recorded and uploaded to GESPAGE. 

 Print2me: secured and available printing from any point of print. 
 User friendly authentication by code, Login/password on the touch screen or by optional 
contactless, magnetic or bar code cards. 
 A personalized interface for the user authenticated (Credit / Quota, Pending prints, Billing job ...). 
 A single interface whatever the peripheral. 
 A friendly selection of the documents to print. 
 Multi-brand compatibility (copiers, multifunction and network printers). 

CPAD 
Touch screen terminal for access control 
and management of printers and MFPs 
Key functions

cPad is then a payment station and enables: 
 users to look for their prints by User name or PC 
name, 
 to provide a fully anonymous service, 
 to pay with the Cartadis magnetic cards (via the 
connection of a TCRS reader). 

 Power supply: 24V 1A. 
 Dimensions of the reader (mm): 188 L / 128 W / 37 H. 
 Weight: 540 g. 
 Compatibility with RFID, magnetic ISO cards via the 
optional TCM3, TCM4, TCMAG2-USB or TCRS readers. 
 7-inch screen; resolution 800*480. 
 16 million colours. 
 Options: fastening bracket or stand. 
Ref: CPAD EN 04/20. CARTADIS reserves the right to alter any feature and/or equipment without forewarning.
